settings.label: Follows
settings.info: Head: where the head looks, smoothed (a stabilized GoPro). Travel: where the rider goes, the right stick looks around.

settings.label: Smoothing
settings.info: How long the view takes to follow a turn (the time constant): more is steadier and lags more.

settings.label: Horizon
settings.info: Locked: always level. Limited: rolls with the head (Head) or leans into turns (Travel), no more than the max roll.

settings.label: Camera tilt
settings.info: Travel only: up (+) or down (-) from the direction of travel.

settings.label: Lens
settings.info: GoPro's horizontal angles (16:9) drawn without fisheye: Narrow 73, Linear 87, Wide 118, SuperView 122 degrees.

settings.label: Head cam: camera beside the rider within
settings.info: The game's camera this close to the rider sideways (and 0.5 to 2.5 m above its feet) counts as the head cam; the third-person camera is metres behind. Show the distance below to tune it.
